spans.s:
जुत् जुत्, cl. 1. A. जोतते, to shine; [cf.
ज्युत्, द्युत्, युत्.]

जुतुम जुतुम and जुथुम, two incorrect
readings for जितुम, q. v.

जूत, अस्, आ, अम्, moved quickly, impelled, urged,
pressed, (at the end of comp. in अद्रि-जूत, इन्द्र-ज्˚,
देव-ज्˚), &c., q. v.)

जूति, इस्, f. going on, proceeding, moving; quick-
ness, speed, velocity; flowing without obstruction or
interruption; impulse, incitement, instigation, anima-
tion; inclination, impulse, energy.
—जूति-मत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, Ved. impetuous, speedy.
जूतिका जूतिका, f. a kind of camphor.
